description: This Java source file defines a class 'PolicyConflictStrategy' which handles conflict scenarios when creating policies that already exist. It extends an abstract strategy class and overrides methods to produce error results upon conflicts, as well as methods to retrieve entity tags related to policies.

classes.name: PolicyConflictStrategy
classes.description: A final class that handles create-policy commands when the policy already exists, producing conflict error results and managing entity tags.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Overrides the abstract method to produce an error result indicating a policy conflict when attempting to create a policy that already exists.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the entity tag of the previous policy entity if it exists, for concurrency control purposes.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the entity tag of the new policy entity if it exists, for concurrency control purposes.
